info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Refunds-v2-spec
info.description: The Ticket Refund Management API allows event organizers and ticketing platforms to retrieve information about refund requests related to ticket purchases. By accessing this API, users can efficiently list and manage refund details for tickets associated with events. This endpoint is designed for developers working within event management systems or ticketing solutions that need to access refund data for reporting, compliance, or customer service purposes. It provides vital insights into refund trends and assists in enhancing customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve refund information for a ticket.
get.description: Fetches the details of the refund process for a specific ticket, including the status and any associated events. This endpoint is crucial for customers wanting to track or confirm refund requests.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary information to process a refund for a specified ticket.
